proofs: git helper returns exactly None or bytes; equality with None agrees with identity on that domain
ref trailing tilde leaves startswith refs/remotes/origin/ invariant; no ref can contain newline
SHA_RE anchors beginning and absolute end with 40 lowercase hex; match and fullmatch accept identical language
YAML safe types have normal metaclasses; comparing type(value) to int by == and is agrees
